questions.q: From whom does all wisdom come, Sirach begins?
questions.evidence: All wisdom comes from the Lord, And is with him forever

questions.q: "To fear the Lord is the beginning of" what, in Sirach 1?
questions.evidence: To fear the Lord is the beginning of wisdom

questions.q: If you come to serve the Lord, Sirach says, prepare your soul for what?
questions.evidence: My son, if you come to serve the Lord, Prepare your soul for temptation

questions.q: When does Sirach tell a son to help his father?
questions.evidence: My son, help your father in his old age

questions.q: A faithful friend is a strong defense, and he who has found one has found what?
questions.evidence: And he that has found him has found a treasure

questions.q: To what does Sirach liken a new friend?
questions.evidence: For the new is not comparable to him: As new wine, so is a new friend

questions.q: What does Sirach say makes atonement for sins, as water quenches fire?
questions.evidence: And almsgiving will make atonement for sins

questions.q: Forgive your neighbor, Sirach says, and what will happen when you pray?
questions.evidence: And then your sins shall be pardoned when you pray

questions.q: What has felled more than the edge of the sword, Sirach says?
questions.evidence: Many have fallen by the edge of the sword: Yet not so many as they that have fallen because of the tongue

questions.q: Whom does Sirach tell you to honor according to your need of him?
questions.evidence: Honor a physician according to your need of him with the honors due to him: For verily the Lord has created him

questions.q: "Let us now praise" whom, Sirach 44 begins?
questions.evidence: Let us now praise famous men, And our fathers that became the father of us

questions.q: Who was beloved of God and men, whose memorial is blessed?
questions.evidence: A man beloved of God and men, even Moses, Whose memorial is blessed

questions.q: Which prophet stood up as fire, his word burning like a torch?
questions.evidence: Also there arose Elijah the prophet as fire, And his word burned like a torch

questions.q: Who wrote the instruction in this book, by its own account?
questions.evidence: I have written in this book the instruction of understanding and knowledge, I Jesus, the son of Sirach Eleazar, of Jerusalem, Who out of his heart poured forth wisdom
